info.title: contextosd
info.description: The ContextOS runtime's HTTP API. Request and record bodies reference the normative ContextOS JSON Schemas by their `$id`; the server also embeds them (`POST /v1/schemas/{doc}/validate`). Every body is parsed with strict ingress (duplicate keys are rejected) and every request is bound to the caller's tenant.

get.summary: Readiness: store reachable and OIDC keys loaded

post.summary: Compile a pinned Context Pack for a request
Negotiate an execution contract against this deployment
Validate a payload against a published schema

get.summary: Verify the caller tenant's signed audit chain

200.description: The chain verifies; `entries` is its length

get.summary: Page the tenant's signed audit chain out

200.description: A page of entries; `next` is the following cursor or null

post.summary: Compile, negotiate and admit a run; with `delegation`, admit a child run in a narrowed lane

get.summary: Lifecycle status and current executor generation

post.summary: Move the run to a new executor; the previous generation goes stale
Govern and dispatch one tool call

200.description: The governed outcome; `result.status` is ok, completed, paused, blocked, rejected or failed

post.summary: Answer a tool's input_required and continue the same operation
Resolve an unknown effect by provider query or evidenced operator assertion
Record a DecisionRecord (lineage verified, evidence gate enforced) and its replay packet
Govern a memory lifecycle operation against trusted memory policy

200.description: The kernel's decision; only allowed records change the memory

get.summary: A memory's current governed lifecycle state

post.summary: MCP server for the run (JSON-RPC 2.0): tools/list of surfaced capabilities, governed tools/call

get.summary: The run's admission inputs as a release-gate replay case (`ctx gate`)

post.summary: Close a delegated child and settle its usage into the parent
Complete the run (no unresolved effect, open child or work in flight)
Cancel the run and its children; stops dispatch and settles children
An independent evaluator's score of a decision, signed into the audit chain
post.description: Policy, utility and safety come from the evaluator; cost and latency are measured by the runtime from the signed decision. Refused (`evaluator_not_independent`) when the caller also holds `admit` or `dispatch`, or is the principal that admitted the run or recorded the decision, whatever token it presents. Only record ids the gateway issued for this run can be scored, and each evaluator scores a decision once.

post.summary: Revoke a tenant, pack, agent, adapter or capability
post.description: Effective for the next dispatch and admission: effects of runs bound to a revoked tenant, pack or agent, and calls to a revoked adapter or capability, are blocked before anything is claimed (`revoked_<kind>`); new runs of a revoked tenant, pack or agent are refused. Audited before it takes effect; idempotent.

bearer.description: An API key (configured as its SHA-256 hash) or an OIDC JWT. Scopes: compile, admit, dispatch, reconcile, audit:read, evaluate (independent evaluators only), control (operators: kill switch).

ExecutorGeneration.name: ContextOS-Executor-Generation
ExecutorGeneration.description: The generation returned by admission or takeover. A stale generation is refused with 409.

ParentExecutorGeneration.name: ContextOS-Executor-Generation
ParentExecutorGeneration.description: Required when the request acts on a parent run (delegation, closing a child): the parent's current generation.

Error.description: Refused. `code` is stable; `message` never carries backend detail. 429 and 503 were not processed and carry Retry-After.

pack_ref.description: A pinned pack reference from the server configuration

features.description: Workflow features to declare; the server derives the rest from the compiled context and refuses inconsistent declarations (`features_invalid`).

admission.description: The run's pinned admission (contract, policy outcomes, controls, limits)

evaluator_ref.description: The pinned evaluator (suite, rubric or judge) and version
